data.explanation: This letter is a first reminder (1. Mahnung) from the publisher of "Muster Magazin" telling you that the payment for your annual subscription is still outstanding. Because payment was missed, they added a EUR 2.50 reminder fee (Mahngebühr) to the original EUR 59.40, so EUR 61.90 in total is now due. If you have already paid, the letter says you can disregard it. Otherwise, transfer the total amount to the IBAN given by the deadline shown to avoid further reminders, additional fees, or the matter being passed on to collections. This is a routine commercial reminder, not from a government authority, so there is no formal legal remedy attached to it.
